responsibility: Declares the front end’s buffered diagnostic framework, including creation and chaining of error/warning/note handles, formatted and token-positioned message construction, flushing to the backend emitter, internal-error termination, and error-scope tracking for modules and procedures. It is the primary public interface for gm2 user diagnostics beneath the higher-level meta-formatting layer.
same_name_distinction: This definition module is the large public API for gm2's diagnostic system, exposing opaque `Error` and `ErrorScope` types plus creation, formatting, flushing, and scope-management procedures. The paired `M2Error.mod` contains the internal data structures and logic that implement buffering, chaining, token lookup, and scope-stack handling.
